arStrings.szText: {c_important}Hemorrhage{/c} also deals {c_number}{payload:DAMAGE_AOE}{/c} damage to enemies around your target.

{c_important}Hemorrhage{/c} deals {c_number}{payload:DAMAGE_COLD}{/c} Cold damage and {c_important}{u}Freezes{/c}{/u} enemies for {c_number}{buffduration:FREEZE}{/c} seconds. An enemy can be {c_important}{u}Frozen{/c}{/u} this way once every {c_number}{SF_17}{/c} seconds.

If {c_important}Hemorrhage{/c} hits an enemy already {c_important}{u}Frozen{/u}{/c}, it has an additional {c_number}[{SF_27}*100|%|]{/c} chance to form a {c_important}{u}Blood Orb{/u}{/c}.

{c_important}Hemorrhage{/c} becomes a {c_important}Darkness{/c} Skill that deals {c_number}{payload:DAMAGE_SHADOW}{/c} Shadow damage.

Instead of forming a {c_important}{u}Blood Orb{/c}{/u}, {c_important}Hemorrhage{/c} Summons a {c_important}Volatile Skeleton{/c} that deals {c_number}{payload:VOLATILE_SKELETON}{/c} damage.
{c_important}Hemorrhage{/c} has an additional {c_number}[{SF_13}*100|%|]{/c} chance to form a {c_important}{u}Blood Orb{/u}{/c}.
